scenarios.name: Starter District
scenarios.description: Market Quarter, gentle oil rise then easing. 3-day campaign.

scenarios.name: Fuel Squeeze
scenarios.description: Oil index climbs 38% by day 4 then partially recovers. Only the external input changes; sellers react via policy.

response.pausePolicy: The world advances 1 tick/second while you are connected. With no live connection for 15s the city pauses and resumes exactly where you left it. The server never fast-forwards more than 5 s of missed time.
response.offlinePolicy: Leaving pauses your city: no fuel burns, no customer bills, no rent and no bankruptcy while you are away. Contracts resume mid-delivery when you return. Economy Lab simulations never touch your save.
response.disclaimer: Credits are imaginary game currency; they cannot be withdrawn, redeemed or traded for money.
